svg.title: Make the workload observable and learn from recovery
svg.desc: A checkout request emits correlated telemetry. An operator uses a tested runbook, updates the decision record from evidence, and rehearses the resulting change. Correlation IDs link events for one request.

text.tspan: Correlation ID: links events for one request.
